display.purpose: Hero game headlines, score counters, and punchy arcade action labels.

body.purpose: High-legibility numbers, form inputs, leaderboard rows, and instructional text.

shadows.name: tactile-button
shadows.purpose: 3D coin-op arcade button bevel providing satisfying tactile depth.

shadows.name: surface-ambient
shadows.purpose: Soft lift for card surfaces and modal overlays against the canvas.

motion.name: tap-bounce
motion.purpose: Rapid spring bounce for cookie tapping and button presses.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Chunky coin-op action button for submitting forms and starting game actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-action { background: #00fe00; color: #0c0342; font-family: 'Odibee Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 10px 24px; border: 2px solid #0c0342; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #0c0342; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease, box-shadow 80ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-action:hover { background: #00e000; } .ds-btn-action:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #0c0342; } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0475ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Alert Button
components.description: Vibrant magenta button for sound toggles, leaderboard access, and alert triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ff0095; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Odibee Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 8px 18px; border: 2px solid #0c0342; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #0c0342; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease, box-shadow 80ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e00083; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #0c0342; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0475ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: The Giant Cookie Tap Button
components.description: Central gameplay target with interactive hover lift and crisp spring compression on tap.
components.css: .ds-btn-cookie { width: 220px; height: 220px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #0c0342; background: #c68a4c; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #0c0342, 0 12px 24px rgba(12,3,66,0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-cookie:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-cookie:active { transform: scale(0.95) translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #0c0342; } .ds-cookie-inner { font-family: 'Odibee Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 2.2rem; color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 2px 2px #0c0342; }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: Clean, high-legibility input box for usernames, passwords, and cookie quantities.
components.css: .ds-field-wrapper { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0c0342; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1.5px solid #b8d4e9; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: #0c0342; font-size: 1rem; font-family: inherit; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0475ff; border-color: #0475ff; }

components.name: Game Panel / Stat Card
components.description: Structured container for live cookie counters, gifting forms, and leaderboard rows.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #b8d4e9; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(12, 3, 66, 0.06); max-width: 420px; } .ds-panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-panel-header h2 { font-family: 'Odibee Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #0c0342; margin: 0; } .ds-stat-badge { background: #00fe00; color: #0c0342; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #0c0342; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Odibee Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 2.8rem; color: #0475ff; margin: 0; line-height: 1; } .ds-stat-value span { font-size: 1.2rem; color: #4b6584; }

narrative.overview:
Cookie Tap is an energetic, high-tactility web game that channels the punchy excitement of a classic 1990s arcade machine into a crisp, responsive web app. It blends vivid arcade blue framing, high-score neon greens, and alert magentas with grounded surfaces that ensure numbers, leaderboard ranks, and inventory counts remain legible in the heat of play.

The interface centers entirely around the physical feedback of the cookie tap, the instant alarm of incoming thief events, and friendly social competition. It explicitly rejects cheap mobile ad clutter, deceptive popups, and dark patterns, as well as sterile monochrome dashboard grids and blurry, unreadable neon overlays.
keyCharacteristics: High-voltage arcade color accents anchored by a solid Cabinet Navy (#0c0342) and clean readable canvas (#f3f8fc)
Distinct dual-tier typography: nostalgic, tall Odibee Sans for arcade headlines and tap counters; clean Inter / system sans for data, leaderboard tables, and form inputs
Chunky, tactile component elevation with springy click compression (translateY(2px) and active scaling) that feels satisfying on both mouse clicks and mobile taps
Instant, unambiguous hazard and state indication: prominent visual banners for thief spawns, sound toggles, and cookie transfers

rules.name: The Neon Purpose Rule
rules.body: Bright accent colors (High-Score Green and Sugar Magenta) are strictly reserved for actionable buttons, active alerts, and live game states. Never use them as decorative body background fills.

rules.name: The High-Contrast Label Rule
rules.body: Green action buttons must always carry Deep Cabinet Navy text (#0c0342) to exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast, never white text.

rules.name: The Data Legibility Rule
rules.body: Never use Odibee Sans inside table rows, form inputs, or small helper text. Dense tabular data and input fields must use Inter for effortless scanning.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Modals and cards sit flat with clean 1px borders. Buttons feature a crisp 4px solid shadow that fully compresses on click.

dos: Do keep button labels in Deep Cabinet Navy (#0c0342) when placing on High-Score Green (#00fe00) to guarantee high contrast.
Do provide immediate visual and acoustic feedback on every cookie tap and thief hit.
Do use Inter for all player numbers, input fields, error messages, and leaderboard rankings.
Do ensure sound toggle controls indicate mute state unambiguously (e.g. 'SOUND: ON' vs 'SOUND: MUTED').
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling intensive shake animations on thief alarms.
donts: Don't clutter screens with fake casino popups, spinning prize wheels, or advertising banners.
Don't use sterile corporate monochrome tables or gray-on-gray dashboard containers.
Don't use illegible jittery pixel fonts or neon-soaked background gradients that cause visual fatigue.
Don't animate background cookie images on hover; preserve image stability.
Don't render text with unreadable low-contrast combinations like white text on lime green.
